condition.description: A CEL expression that is true or false. The first match whose condition holds decides; a match without one always does. Facts and functions: https://github.com/lustefaniak/prbar/blob/main/docs/rules.md#reference-facts

output.description: What this rule decides, as YAML fields, or as a quoted CEL expression for an output that has to be computed.

oneOf.description: A CEL map with the same fields, for an output that has to be computed: '{"rule": "x", "action": <a CEL expression>}'.

rule.description: Rules that apply only when this match's condition holds; when none of them matches, evaluation goes on after this match.

action.description: What PRBar posts on its own once the review is in. approve: A GitHub approval, with an empty body unless `attribution`. request_changes: A "request changes" review with the summary as its body. comment: A comment review with the summary, no verdict. share: The findings as inline comments, no verdict and no body, and the review request restored so the next push is reviewed again. Posts nothing when no finding reaches `min_severity`. flag: Shown in PRBar as a request for changes; nothing is posted. none: Nothing is posted.

attribution.description: With approve: a one-line body naming PRBar and the review's confidence.

inline.description: Post the findings as inline comments. Default: off for approve, on otherwise.

max_comments.description: At most this many inline comments, worst first. Default: 20 for share, no cap otherwise.

min_severity.description: Only findings at or above this severity go inline. Default: info.

rule.description: The rule's id: shown in PRBar with the decision, in `rules history` and in `rules explain`. Make it say what the rule is for.

match.description: Tried top to bottom; the first whose condition holds decides.

variables.description: Named sub-expressions, read in conditions as variables.<name>.

description: A policy in rules/decide/: what PRBar posts once a review is in. The stage's files run in name order and the first match decides; with no match, the prbar.yaml settings do. Guide: https://github.com/lustefaniak/prbar/blob/main/docs/rules.md
title: PRBar decide rules
